validation_ack.reason: PUT III added 500,013,138 shares in July 2020, and the FY2020 audited FS compute basic EPS Rp2.70 on a weighted average of 5,886,539,664 shares (Note 42, PDF p. 123 of https://www-cms.bankneo.co.id/storage/files/1/Laporan%20Keuangan/Laporan%20Keuangan%20Tahunan%20(audited)/LKT%202020.pdf). 2.70 x 5,886,539,664 = Rp15.9bn = reported profit; FY-end shares are 6,661,795,239. Real weighted-average effect, not a data error.

Two rights issues in 2021 (PUT IV +832.7m shares in June, PMHMETD V +1,927.2m shares in December): basic loss per share Rp-114.07 is on a weighted average of 8,646,426,261 shares (FY2021 FS Note 40, PDF p. 152). -114.07 x 8,646,426,261 = Rp-986.3bn = reported loss; FY-end shares are 9,421,681,836.

The 2,617,133,843 PMHMETD VI shares were listed in Nov 2022 but booked as 'Dana setoran modal' until Jan 2023, so the FY2022 FS compute loss per share Rp-83.75 on a weighted average of 9,422 million shares (Note 41, PDF p. 176): -83.75 x 9,421.7m = Rp-789.1bn = reported loss. shares_out stores the 12,038,815,679 registered/listed shares (Note 24, PDF p. 144).

PMHMETD VII added 1,311,666,667 shares in July/August 2024; FY2024 basic EPS Rp1.58 is on a weighted average of 12,585 million shares (FY2024 FS Note 41, PDF p. 169): 1.58 x 12,585m = Rp19.9bn = reported profit; FY-end shares 13,350,482,346.

The AGMS of 31 Mar 2021 allocated 10% of FY2020 profit (Rp1,587,150,269.5) but fixed the dividend at Rp0.23 per share (10% would be Rp0.238), so the amount paid was 0.23 x 6,661,795,239 = Rp1,532,212,905 (FY2021 FS Note 22, PDF p. 127) = 9.65% of profit. payout_ratio stores the 10% as reported; total stores the amount paid.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document except two corporate-action dates came straight from the bank's own CMS (https://www-cms.bankneo.co.id/storage/files/...), linked from the IR page https://www.bankneocommerce.co.id/id/company-information/investor-relation (Next.js page; links read from its __NEXT_DATA__ JSON) and the GCG page (GMS results). Plain curl with a browser User-Agent on 2026-11-03, no bot challenge. idx.co.id answers 403 to this server and was not used. PUT II (2019) dates come from a KSEI circular fetched from the Internet Archive; PUT III (2020) dates from a Kontan news article (no official schedule retrievable).

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk (formerly PT Bank Yudha Bhakti Tbk; renamed 2020; controlled by PT Akulaku Silvrr Indonesia since 2021) has no subsidiaries, associates or JVs (AR2025 PDF p. 93); its audited statements are non-consolidated 'Laporan Keuangan' = the whole entity. Money fields carry basis 'consolidated' (validator rule; same approach as MEGA), ratios 'bank_only' as printed in the OJK published-report ratio tables. equity_attr = total_equity (no NCI). Auditor: KAP Purwantono, Sungkoro & Surja / Purwanto, Susanti & Surja (EY).
UNITS: FY2019-FY2021 statements are in full Rupiah (divided by 1e9, full precision kept); FY2022 onwards and the 2025-2026 interims in Rp juta (divided by 1,000).

LOSS YEARS ARE REAL: net loss Rp-986.3bn (2021), -789.1bn (2022), -573.2bn (2023) while the neobank was built (marketing, ATM fees, heavy provisions on channelled Akulaku-ecosystem loans); first profit since 2020 in 2024 (Rp19.9bn), Rp565.7bn in 2025, Rp431.0bn in 9M2026. Ratios outside the validator's plausibility ranges are real, not unit slips: ROE -84.61 and ROA -13.71 (2021), BOPO 224.01 and CIR 254.73 (2021), NIM 18.39 (2023) and 17.30 (2024), CoC 13.4/25.1/23.9/16.1 (2022-2025). All are as printed by the bank and match across the OJK published reports, AR2025 PDF p. 12 and the Pubex 2026 deck.

RATIO SOURCES: CAR, NPL gross/net, ROA, ROE, NIM, BOPO, CIR and LDR for each FY come from the bank's audited-period OJK published report (Laporan Rasio Keuangan Triwulanan, Dec of the same year, PDF p. 7), which are identical to the AR2025 highlights for 2021-2025 except that the AR prints a 'Loan to Funding Ratio (LFR)' (56.73/73.21/79.94/69.20/55.62) instead of the LDR (52.63/70.89/77.73/67.53/51.21) - LDR stored. LAR, NPL coverage and CoC (no filing discloses them) come from one consistent company source, the Public Expose 2025 deck of 31 Mar 2026 (5-year table, PDF p. 12); older decks print different values for some years (noted per datum). CASA: FY2023 from the FY2024 deck chart (29%, rounded), FY2024-FY2025 from the Pubex 2026 chart; the bank's CASA ratio uses TPF including interbank deposits. FY2020 LAR/coverage/CoC/CASA and FY2021-FY2022 CASA are not disclosed (null; AR texts give only the time-deposit share, not computed). AR2025 PDF p. 33 prints a CIR of 32.58% for 2025 in the Board of Commissioners' report, contradicting 31.33% on PDF p. 48 and in the published report - 31.33% stored.

RIGHTS ISSUES / SHARE COUNT (drive the price checks): no split, reverse split or bonus issue since 2019 (last bonus shares May 2017). Six rights issues with ex-dates (regular market): PUT II 2019-06-14 (34:3 @Rp338), PUT III 2020-06-29 (14:3 @Rp300, only 38% taken up), PUT IV 2021-06-10 (8:1 @Rp300), PMHMETD V 2021-11-29 (35:9 @Rp1,300), PMHMETD VI 2022-11-21 (18:5 @Rp650), PMHMETD VII 2024-07-09 (700,000,000:76,267,192 @Rp300). Plus one non-pre-emptive private placement (PMTHMETD) of 469,591,963 shares listed 22/25 Mar 2019 (AR2019 PDF p. 66, AR2025 PDF p. 94) - not a rights/split/bonus type, so not in corporate_actions. Share count: 5,192,586,184 (2018) -> 6,161,782,101 (2019) -> 6,661,795,239 (2020) -> 9,421,681,836 (2021) -> 12,038,815,679 (2022) -> 13,350,482,346 (2024 onward). The EGMS approvals of 2023 for a further PMTHMETD and the 2025-2026 GMS agendas (articles amendments, management changes) produced no new shares (AR2025 PDF p. 16: no corporate action in 2025; 9M2026 FS: 13,350,482,346). Yahoo may price-adjust BBYB history for these rights issues; the fetcher's reversal should be checked against the year-end prices here.

PER-SHARE BASIS: there was never a split, so share_basis is simply the period-end date of each figure. Reported EPS uses weighted-average shares and differs from profit / FY-end shares in 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2024 (rights issues; acknowledged in validation_ack with the weighted counts). FY2022 is special: the PMHMETD VI shares were listed in Nov 2022 but the FS booked the Rp1.70tn as 'Dana setoran modal' and kept 9,421,681,836 in share capital until Jan 2023; shares_out stores the 12,038,815,679 registered shares (Note 24).

YEAR-END PRICE CONFLICT FY2020: AR2020 (monthly table) gives a Dec 2020 close of Rp298; AR2021's quarterly table gives Rp366 for Q4 2020, but its 2020 closing prices (298/252/300/366) are AR2020's Feb/Apr/Jul/Oct closes (Rp366 is the October close), so Rp298 is stored; check against the price file. AR2020/AR2021 also print 'total shares' about 1% below the FS counts (e.g. 6,595,177,287 vs 6,661,795,239) - FS counts used.

DIVIDENDS: the only cash dividend out of FY2020-FY2025 profit is the FY2020 final (Rp0.23/share, Rp1.53bn, ex 12 Apr 2021). FY2021-FY2023: losses, AGMS resolved no dividend. FY2024 and FY2025: profit wholly retained (AGMS 27 May 2025, 30 Apr 2026). payout_ratio = 0 for 2021-2025 with the AGMS source. (The FY2019 dividend of Rp1.60bn, Rp0.24/share, paid 3 Sep 2020, is out of scope.) The FY2020 payment date conflicts: FS/IR table 3 May 2021 vs KSEI schedule 5 May 2021 (stored).

INTERIM: 9M2026 (30 Sep 2026) interim FS and OJK published report are on the IR page (no 9M2026 deck or press release yet). LAR is null because the published report prints KKR 0.00%, which is impossible next to NPL 2.78% (2Q26 deck: LAR 13.0%). CoC, NPL coverage and CASA are not in the 9M documents (null). Prior-year balances come from the 9M2025 interim FS. Management changes approved by the EGMS of 29 Oct 2026 (new President Director Christian Lesmana, pending OJK) - no capital action.

KBMI: AR2021 (PDF p. 115) states the bank moved from BUKU II to KBMI I under POJK 12/POJK.03/2021; core capital is still far below the Rp6tn KBMI 1 ceiling (Rp4,354.6bn at 30 Sep 2026). Not a sharia bank; no sharia unit.
